Score breakdown (criterion, weight, value, contribution)

Limitations

PSI has no partial-gravity data: microgravity and 1 g bound the interval; E-FIELD only emulates partial gravity. LUCI and FM2 are future work.

ACME-CFI-G: some tests report oxygen in the burner (oxidizer) stream, not in the surrounding atmosphere; they are not counted as ambient oxygen.

BASS-II: scenario oxygen 30% is outside the tested range 13.6-22.2%; any conclusion is an extrapolation.

BASS-II: no ambient pressure reported, so the scenario cannot be compared.

CFI: scenario oxygen 30% is outside the tested range 17-21%; any conclusion is an extrapolation.

BASS: no ambient oxygen reported, so the scenario cannot be compared.
